approved_scope.title: Keep a passing check green when the Action's PR comment is refused for a read-only token
approved_scope.description: Keep a passing check green when the Action's PR comment is refused for a read-only token
acceptance_criteria: A behavioural test runs the step script from action.yml against a fake gh for 403 on each call, a 500, and success; it fails before the fix
Any other gh error in the comment step still fails the step
The github-action docs comment row and CHANGELOG say a read-only token degrades to a warning plus job summary
The posting and updating paths with a writable token are unchanged

With comment: true and a token GitHub refuses (HTTP 403) on the comment lookup, create or update, the Post PR Comment step exits 0, emits a ::warning naming the missing pull-requests: write permission, and writes the comment markdown to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY (CI-3.b)

answers.constraints: CI-3.b; REQ-github fork-PR read-only behaviour: fork PRs run without secrets or comment writes; checksum verification and the archive gate are unchanged
